question: Where can lines be added to the resources branch of the province tooltip, and what appends to its text?

addresses.name: ProvinceTooltip_Mode10_AfterGoods
addresses.no_signature: a join inside ProvinceTooltip_Build, not a function
addresses.comment: The join in the resources branch (map mode 10) between the four goods' lines and the strategic resource's: mov ecx,[edi+0x10] / mov edx,[ecx], five bytes. Reached by both intelligence tests (0x9BAAB, 0x9BABE), crude oil's skip (0x9C0EA) and the last good's fall-through, so reaching it says nothing about the player's intelligence. edi is the province's +8 subobject; the text being built is the string at [esp+0xB8]. Hooked by BiceLib to add manpower and leadership. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-mapmode.md, the section on the tooltip following the mode.
addresses.evidence: Bytes read as 8b 4f 10 8b 11. cfg.py --lands-in 0x49C2EB 0x49C2F1 from the arm lists exactly the three jumps, all to the first byte; a linear disassembly of 0x498000-0x49D400 references none of the bytes after it. Would be shown wrong by a branch into 0x49C2ED-0x49C2F0 from outside the disassembled range.

addresses.name: std::string::appendWhole
addresses.comment: Appends text to this, whole, and returns this: push -1 / push 0 / push eax / mov ecx,esi / call std::string::appendString / mov eax,esi / ret. Register arguments only. The tooltip builders append each finished line through it.
addresses.evidence: Read whole at 0xA5B1D0, seven instructions, ending in a bare ret; the call's target 0x33E30 is std::string::appendString in the record, with (text, 0, -1). Callers at 0x49BC3E, 0x49BE48 and 0x49C391 set ESI to the tooltip's text and leave the string to add in EAX. Would be shown wrong by a caller passing either in another register.
